description: M2: Core Systems - Peg state shaders, mutation engine, synergies, special peg behaviors, corruption spread, and ball trails

userStories.title: Peg State Shader
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a shader that visually transforms pegs based on their blessing/corruption state so players can see mutations.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shaders/peg_state.gdshader
Shader accepts corruption_level uniform (0.0 = blessed gold, 0.5 = neutral, 1.0 = cursed crimson)
Shader accepts mutation_pulse uniform (animated sine wave driving green pustule effect)
Shader accepts void_factor uniform (0.0-1.0 driving star-field overlay)
Interpolates visual: gold veins (0.0) → neutral (0.5) → crimson cracks (1.0)
Mutation pulse creates green pustule effect when corruption_level ≈ 0.5
Apply shader to all peg types via ShaderMaterial
Tweaking uniforms visibly shifts peg appearance
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Corruption Spread Shader
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a shader on the board background that spreads corruption visually like ink in water.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shaders/corruption_spread.gdshader
Shader accepts sampler2D corruption_map uniform (64x64 Image)
Shader blurs and bleeds corruption map across background
Create GDScript to maintain 64x64 Image for corruption map
On peg_state_changed to 'cursed', paint circle on Image at peg position
Update shader texture when map changes
Cursing a peg visibly spreads ink across board background
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Ball Trail Effect
userStories.description: As a developer, I need a visual trail effect following balls so players can see their path through the board.
acceptanceCriteria: Create shaders/ball_trail.gdshader
Ball script maintains Array of last 20 positions
Line2D added to ball scene, points updated each frame
Shader fades opacity: tail (0.0) → head (1.0)
Shader shifts color: white → ghost-blue toward tail
Ball leaves visible fading trail as it falls
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Mutation Engine Integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the MutationEngine to subscribe to peg hits and manage state transitions so pegs evolve over time.
acceptanceCriteria: MutationEngine subscribes to EventBus.peg_hit signal
Tracks hit_count per peg instance
After 5 hits (MUTATION_THRESHOLD), 15% chance to mutate on each subsequent hit
State transitions follow rules: Dormant→Blessed/Cursed, Blessed→Mutant (30%), Cursed→Mutant (40%), Mutant→Void (10%)
Emits EventBus.peg_state_changed on transition
Updates shader uniforms on peg instance
Hit a peg 5+ times and watch it visibly mutate
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Synergy Checker Integration
userStories.description: As a developer, I need SynergyChecker to track tag counts and activate synergies so players can build powerful combos.
acceptanceCriteria: SynergyChecker subscribes to EventBus.peg_state_changed and EventBus.peg_spawned
Maintains tag count dictionary: { 'death': 3, 'growth': 2, ... }
Checks 5 synergies against tag counts: necrotic_bloom, cursed_flame, void_choir, bleeding_arch, profane_eye
Requires minimum 3 pegs for synergy activation
Emits synergy_activated/synergy_broken/synergy_scaled as appropriate
Debug: print active synergies to console on any change
Place 3 Fungal + 3 Bone pegs manually → 'necrotic_bloom' activates in console
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Oracle Peg Special Behavior
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Oracle peg to split balls on hit so it provides strategic value.
acceptanceCriteria: Oracle Peg overrides _on_body_entered method
On hit: spawn 2 additional balls at ±15° angle offset from original trajectory
New balls inherit parent ball's velocity magnitude
All balls continue physics simulation independently
Oracle peg emits EventBus.peg_hit as normal
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Void Rift Peg Special Behavior
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Void Rift peg to teleport balls and grant gold so it provides resource value.
acceptanceCriteria: Void Rift Peg overrides _on_body_entered method
On hit: queue_free ball (remove from physics)
Add +10 gold via RunState.gold += 10
Ball teleport simulates entering best available pocket
Void Rift emits EventBus.peg_hit as normal
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Ember Peg Special Behavior
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Ember peg to corrupt adjacent pegs on hit so it spreads destruction.
acceptanceCriteria: Ember Peg overrides _on_body_entered method
On hit: iterate all pegs in group 'pegs'
For each adjacent peg (within 3 peg distances): shift corruption_level toward cursed by 0.1
Adjacent pegs emit EventBus.peg_state_changed if state changes
Ember peg emits EventBus.peg_hit as normal
Project compiles without errors in Godot

userStories.title: Fungal Peg Special Behavior
userStories.description: As a developer, I need the Fungal peg to spawn new Sprout pegs periodically so the board can grow.
acceptanceCriteria: Fungal Peg checks RunState.total_drops % 3 == 0 after each drop phase
When triggered: check adjacent empty slots (within 2 peg distances)
25% chance to spawn Sprout peg in random empty adjacent slot
Sprout peg is a lighter variant of Fungal (same type, starts at Dormant)
New peg emits EventBus.peg_spawned
Fungal peg emits EventBus.peg_hit as normal
Project compiles without errors in Godot
